headline: Ivory Coast and Serbia battle to 2-1

story:
The clash between Ivory Coast and Serbia in Group I was a classic matchday 3 encounter. Both teams showed incredible tactical discipline and passion on the pitch, leaving the fans at the edge of their seats.

The final score of 2-1 reflects the intensity of the game. Key tactical adjustments from both managers ensured that the match remained a balanced and highly competitive affair until the final whistle.

With this result, both Ivory Coast and Serbia look forward to their next challenges, knowing that every single point could be decisive in their quest for World Cup glory.
